judge_input.description:
# Summary of Changes

Deprecates `falcon.testing.redirected` in favor of the standard library's `contextlib.redirect_stdout` and `contextlib.redirect_stderr`.

**Changes:**
- Added a deprecation warning to `falcon.testing.redirected` using `falcon.util.deprecated`
- Updated the internal test file (`test_cmd_inspect_app.py`) to use `contextlib` alternatives
- Scheduled for removal in Falcon 5.0

**Rationale:**
- pytest already captures and suppresses output from successful tests
- The stdlib gives equivalent functionality via `contextlib.redirect_stdout` and `contextlib.redirect_stderr`
- Reduces maintenance burden by removing a redundant utility

# Related Issues

Fixes #2569

# Pull Request Checklist

- [x] Applied changes to both WSGI and ASGI paths.
- [x] Added **tests** for changed code.
- [x] Ran automated tests and quality checks by [running `tox`](https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/stable/community/contributing.html#pull-requests).
- [x] Prefixed code comments with GitHub nick and prefix.
- [x] Coding style consistent with the framework.
- [x] Updated **documentation** for changed code.
    - [x] Added docstrings for new classes/functions/modules.
    - [x] Updated docstrings for existing-code changes.
    - [x] Updated both WSGI and ASGI docs.
    - [x] Added references to new classes/functions/modules in the RST file under `docs/`.
    - [x] Updated all supporting docs under `docs/`.
    - [x] Copyright notice at the top of new modules.
    - [x] Changed classes/methods/functions have `versionadded`, `versionchanged`, or `deprecated` [directives](http://www.sphinx-doc.org/en/stable/usage/restructuredtext/directives.html?highlight=versionadded#directive-versionadded).
- [x] Changes have [towncrier news fragments](https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/stable/community/contributing.html#changelog) under `docs/_newsfragments/`, named `{issue_number}.{fragment_type}.rst`.
- [x] LLM output reviewed and tested by a human developer (see [Use of LLMs ("AI")](https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/latest/community/contributing.html#use-of-llms-ai)).
